stock.description: China Ruifeng Renewable Energy Holdings Limited, an investment holding enterprise established in 2005 and based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, primarily focuses on wind power generation across the People's Republic of China. Its operations encompass running wind farms, manufacturing wind turbine blades and components, and providing maintenance services for electrical and mechanical equipment. The company also offers money lending, produces health-related products, and delivers management and administrative solutions. Notably, it changed its name to China Ruifeng Renewable Energy Holdings Limited in June 2013, having previously been known as China Ruifeng Galaxy Renewable Energy Holdings Limited.
